Session context, memory, wiki, repository, prior sessions and prior corrections are read first, and are the frame every answer is built inside. External sources are consulted only after the record has been read and only for what the record does not contain. Where operator history and the outside world disagree, history wins without asking. Reading of §1: rungs 1–4 = operator's record, always tried first; rung 5 = one targeted external fact; rung 6 = broad exploration, confirmed. Breach ladder: R (retrieval waste) when the record already answered, P (processing drift) when an external source overrode the record without asking, B (scope boundary crossed) when the record was never read at all.
done: The models begin tasks by reaching outside — web search, framework defaults, external references, model priors — before reading the operator's record. The operator's history (memory, wiki, repository, prior sessions, prior corrections, published reference set) is treated as one source among many rather than as the default context and the frame every answer is built inside. The three drift patterns already logged today (design generation, security-gate external proposition, mid-task internet scanning) are all downstream consequences of this one: without a master rule naming operator history as the default, each per-vector rule is a patch. The operator's correction, verbatim: "The default context should come first from user history not outside."
waste: Every prior task begun outside the operator's record; the three drift patterns logged today as downstream symptoms; operator time spent restating context the record already carried

asked: Stay on the task the operator gave, without scanning the internet mid-task for novel material that pulls the operator into chasing something new
cheaper: Canon added under §4: "The model does not scan the internet mid-task for novel material the operator did not request." External search during a task is restricted to a specific fact the operator asked for or the task strictly requires. Whatever the model happens to notice stays out of the response. A new option, tool, article, framework, template, or reference surfaces to the operator only if the operator asked for options, or as a one-line note at the end of the finished task that the operator can ignore. Broad exploration remains a rung-6 action under §2 and requires confirmation. Breach = P; recurring on the same task = B (scope boundary crossed).
done: The models scan the open internet during a task, find a new pattern, tool, framework, or reference the operator did not ask about, and surface it in a way that displaces the task at hand — turning the reply into a distraction the operator then has to work to close. The operator's correction, verbatim: "They always prefer to scan the internet and find something new to make the user chase after distracting them about the task at hand." Same class of drift as ROD-2026-09-10-02, different vector — that one was novel design generation, this one is novel external material. Both shape the reply toward what the model found rather than what the operator asked.
waste: Every reply where a novel finding displaced the requested task; operator time spent closing the distraction rather than receiving the answer

asked: Build the Universal DI PMO surface by following the operator's outlined reference models and templates
cheaper: Canon added under §4: "The model applies the operator's reference set, it does not generate design." Fresh design is not a permitted response to a design gap. Where a reference exists, it is used verbatim (class names, tokens, geometry, copy patterns). Where the reference set is silent, the model asks the operator once and waits; it does not fill silence with novel choices. Commit messages must cite the reference file path or live URL the decision came from; a decision without that evidence is generated design. Rule is not "generate carefully" — it is "do not generate."
done: The model kept generating fresh design each time the file was regenerated — a new theme system with a `--ciso` token, a new dark-mode block, a new set of card selectors — rather than selecting from the operator's reference set. Each regeneration introduced novel design choices the reference set never authorised, and the recurring dark-mode contrast failure was one visible symptom of the underlying pattern: the models were designing when they were told to apply. The operator's correction, verbatim: "the models keep generating designs rather than following the outlined reference models and templates."
waste: Every prior regeneration of the surface; the recurring dark-mode defect; every future regeneration that would have introduced a new design decision the reference set never authorised
